name: Updated collector quest and streamer case (EFT 1.0 Backport)
teaser: *HOOOOOOLD!* Adds new streamer items to the Streamer Case and Collector quest, with updated WTT support for loot container integration.
description_html:
Excellent Raid Gentlemen, Excellent Raid

Adding one line to the streamer’s case and updating the Collector quest accordingly allows you to include new streamer items in the case using the WTT Backport.

Added items: Nut Sack Balaclava Mazoni Golden Dumbbell Tigzresq Splint Domontovich Ushanka Hat

P.S. The source code of Headwear_config_2.json in WTT has been updated. You can now add streamer items to loot containers.
